content: Relevance of NvBlockDescriptor . timingEvent . period For any given NvBlockDescriptor , the value of the attribute NvBlockDescrip- tor . nvBlockNeeds . cyclicWritingPeriod shall be ignored and the value of NvBlockDescriptor . timingEvent . period shall be taken to specify the effective writing frequency for cyclic storage.
